name: RAG Search Engine
description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) search engine with query UI, Go vector search API, Python document ingestion & embedding worker, PostgreSQL database, and Valkey cache.

services.name: webapp
services.description: Node.js Web Search UI with live query input, vector search results & document viewer

services.name: apigateway
services.description: Go REST API processing search queries, vector similarity matching & document retrieval

services.name: aiworker
services.description: Python document ingestion worker generating text embeddings & chunking knowledge base files

services.name: dbpostgres
services.description: PostgreSQL database storing document metadata, text chunks & vector embeddings

services.name: cachevalkey
services.description: Valkey cache storing high-frequency search query embeddings & search result caches
